commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' The resulting corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared by the defence.

90+3' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Vicente Guaita sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+2' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
88' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
86' That was close. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
85' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Celta Vigo win a corner.
85' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick.
81' 1 - 1 Goal! Williot Swedberg shows great vision to find Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
78' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) for a tough tackle.

75' Bryan Gil (Girona) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
72' Michel has decided to substitute Yangel Herrera and he is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
72' That will be all from Abel Ruiz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Portu (Girona).
72' Substitution. Arnaut Danjuma makes his way off the pitch and Bryan Gil (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
68' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
65' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) replaces Pablo Duran.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ilaix Moriba walks off the pitch to be replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
64' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
61' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
59' A poor mid-range free-kick by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
58' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Celta Vigo have a free kick from a promising distance.
58' It is time for a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is on for Borja Iglesias.
58' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Alfonso Gonzalez is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
54' Michel is forced to make a change. Daley Blind (Girona) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by David Lopez.
51' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
46' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Giraldez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo). He is replaced by Hugo Alvarez.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+3' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Donny van de Beek (Girona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
43' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.

38' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Yangel Herrera (Girona) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Daley Blind and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

37' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
37' Foul! Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Girona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
30' 37:63 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

22' The opposition back off Arnaut Danjuma (Girona), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita denies him with the save.
21' The foul by Yangel Herrera (Girona) was seen by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
14' Michel is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Oriol Romeu (Girona) suffers an injury and Donny van de Beek comes on.
12' Oriol Romeu (Girona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
5' Abel Ruiz (Girona) wins the aerial battle and plants a header at goal from near the penalty after a good cross from Oriol Romeu. It's a fine attempt but sails narrowly wide of the left post.
4' Yangel Herrera (Girona) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
2' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
1' The match has just started.
Girona will kick the game off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will supervise the game today.
